author: /root/quantitative_route
scope: Common actual K,A are chosen before every component, transport, state, endpoint and point. Arbitrary c,d remain compatible with the separately constructed normalization buffer.
The original geometry supplies both closed-collar MapsTo facts through the reviewed signed-barrier theorem. A single Bool-side argument handles both caps.
Same-point cases, including true ambient identity, reuse the actual collar comparison at the point itself, without incorrectly requiring unscaled E0>=1.
Interior caps use the actual physical endpoint distance. No cell containing the positive component, target material ratio, new material witness or altered transport is assumed.
